chunks: And by this chain, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Al-Harith Al-Nasri, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Statement of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'Those who have changed Allah's favour for ungratefulness.' He (peace be upon him) asked: 'What are you saying about that?' I said, 'We say that these are the tyrants from Quraish, the Clan of Umayya and the Clan of Al-Mugheira.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Then he said: By Allah, this is about Quraish in its entirety.'

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and High, addressed His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'I gave preference to Quraish over the Arabs, and Completed upon them My Favour, and Sent to them My Messenger, so they changed My Favour by denial and made their people to alight into the abode of perdition.'

key_terms.الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُف: Those who changed Allah's favour for ungratefulness (Quranic phrase)

ai.seo_question: Who does the Quranic verse 'Those who changed Allah's favour for ungratefulness' refer to according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (AS) expands the scope of the verse to encompass the entire tribe of Quraish, correcting the initial assumption that it referred only to specific rival clans like the Umayyads. He contextualizes this by recalling Allah's specific declaration of favoring Quraish over other Arabs, emphasizing that their collective ingratitude (kufur) in rejecting the Prophet transformed divine grace into a cause for their descent into perdition.
